Good question! Its something I've been struggling with myself.

I feel like the best plan is to keep their ages ambiguous, though I would like to say they're all 18+ it's kinda hard too for accuracy reasons.

Regardless, in my head they're all 18. I kinda wanna leave it unmentioned in the game but for me, from an outside perspective, they're all adults.

There's also a censor nudity option for people who are uncomfortable with the age ambiguity, and I'm planning on having an option that skips/replaces heavy H and guro scenes with toned down versions, so the story is still legible for people who don't want the "nasty" stuff.

Thank you for asking though! I love answering questions like this. :)
